comments.author: Steward
comments.body: little trick to leveling your trade skillz is take your base level and times it by 20... then buy that many items and no more. so if your level 3 and you could buy 120 firearms then buy 60 two times. this is cause your trade skills can only go up by 20 proficany no matter how many trade goods you buy.

comments.author: Hawthorne
comments.body: Visby is another good place to grind Firearms Trading if you're in the North Sea. You will need to have a 17th century chrono title, though.

comments.author: Aguirre
comments.body: The Golden Sceptre which is plundered from the Black Sea formidable fleets also gives +1 to firearms trading.

comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
Unlisted boosts:

Weapon: Golden Scepter -- +1
Shoes: Loyalty Boots -- +1
Outfit: Steam Engineer's Work Suit / Steam Engineer's Dress Suit -- +2 (male/female)

The outfit is fairly rare due to only having been available in the UWC Cash shop / Cove in times past. The weapon is obtainable from specific fleets. The shoes tend to only surface during Holy Roman Emperor elections (and only if players meet the right conditions to receive them).
